{{Quote|Is Lando Calrissian the coolest character in all of ''Star Wars''? Depends on who you ask, probably. But if you ask ''me'', the answer is yes, and I plan to prove it with this story.|Charles Soule|<ref name="SWB" />}}
'''''Star Wars: Lando''''' is a [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries starring [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] from creators [[Charles Soule]] and [[Alex Maleev]]. The first issue debuted on [[July 8]], [[2015]]. The events of the series take place prior to Calrissian becoming [[Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City]]. The story also includes [[Lobot]].

The series received a sequel in the form of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Droids|Dark Droids]]'' tie in arc to Soule's 2020 [[Star Wars (2020)|''Star Wars'' (2020)]] run, starting with [[Star Wars (2020) 37|issue 37]] and lasting until [[Star Wars (2020) 41|''Star Wars'' (2020) 41]].<ref name="Sequel">{{Twitter|CharlesSoule|status/1687253578266656768|[[Charles Soule]]|quote=You remember that LANDO miniseries I did with @alexmaleev and @paulmounts back in 2015? Folks seemed to like it. STAR WARS #37-41 is a direct sequel to that story, and I think the ending is even better.|archivedate=20230807143152}}</ref>
